events.title: BTC dipped below $60,000 in the last 24 hours (low $58,769) and recovered

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 23 November 2026**

**Alert**
• BTC dipped below $60,000 in the last 24 hours (low $58,769) and recovered. It matters because $60,000 is the line the market keeps testing: price is back near $61,177, but it has not yet held clearly above it.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $61,177, down about 6% over 7 days and about 24% over 30 days.
• Headline: **NEUTRAL**, confidence LOW. The last few weeks lean down; the medium-term reading has been weak for three days, and the headline turns BEARISH after five. The long-term trend still reads up, but only barely.
• Fear & Greed: 11 out of 100 (extreme fear). The US stock fear index VIX is near 36, very high.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Bitcoin moved between about $58,800 and $61,400 and ended back above $61,000 (CoinGecko); no single cause is reported.
• About $233 million of bets were forced to close across crypto in 24 hours, mostly bets on a fall (PANews). Exchanges saw a net outflow of about 10,496 BTC in a day (PANews).
• Abraxas Capital bought about $897 million of Bitcoin into the drop, and Michael Saylor hinted Strategy may keep buying (PANews).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
The short term is weak and the month leans down.
• Turns up: a close above $63,250 (top of a typical week's swing), then $67,975 (200-week average).
• Sideways: between $58,952 and $63,250; a normal week lately swings about $3,971.
• Turns down: a close below $58,952 (the 30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 11 November; a fresh drop signal would come near $59,692 and a rally signal would need about $70,073.
• Scheduled: US October PCE inflation this week (institutions expect 3.8%, PANews), Thanksgiving market closures, and the Fed meeting on 8 December.

**News that matters**
• Chainflip's hack losses rise to about $12 million and Fusionist's bridge is exploited (PANews): short term, small negative.
• Institutions expect US inflation to rise to 3.8%, which may lift December rate-rise talk (PANews): medium term, small negative.
• Abraxas Capital buys about $897 million of Bitcoin (PANews): medium term, positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• A weekend of hacks: Chainflip, Fusionist and wallet app Fluidkey, and Upbit and Bithumb paused CYBER transfers after an abnormal minting (PANews). Stablecoins keep spreading: PayPal's PYUSD0 on Aptos and Samsung Wallet USDC on Sui (Pluang).
• New on Reku: Fusionist (ACE) was hit by a bridge exploit that minted trillions of unbacked tokens (PANews); ACE is down about 17% in 7 days.

**Bigger picture**
Next month leans down until Bitcoin wins back $76,173 (50-day average); the 3-6 month picture still leans up only while the 200-day average keeps rising, and is back on track above $72,236.

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Paid / Digital:** Hold trader-targeted spend at the planned level and keep a reserve: the Rally watch drop window has been open since 11 November and Bitcoin (about $61,177) is about 10% under its 200-week average. Lean new-user ads on trust, safety and stablecoin explainers, and pause any campaign that falls below its 30-day return stop. Keep rally creatives ready to launch if Bitcoin closes back above $67,975.

**Social:** Keep the normal rhythm with a calm, factual daily recap (Bitcoin about $61,177, down about 6% in a week). The most useful topic is safety after a weekend of hacks: Chainflip's losses rose to about $12 million, Fusionist's bridge was exploited and an iPhone exploit chain was used to steal wallet recovery phrases (PANews). Add a short 'what is PCE and why crypto watches it' post ahead of this week's US inflation release.

**CRM:** Send existing holders a calm update: Bitcoin is down about 24% in a month and is holding near $61,000, with US inflation data this week and the Fed on 8 December as the next scheduled events, with no forecast and no push to trade. Add a safety reminder (2FA, phone updates, never share a recovery phrase) after this weekend's hacks (PANews). Keep the onboarding journey queued, not live: sign-ups tend to arrive 2-4 weeks after a rally, not during a drop.

**SEO:** Pintu and Pluang are both covering Bitcoin's fall and whether it has bottomed (Pintu's 'Bitcoin Jebol US$56.000, Terendah Sejak 2024' and 'Bitcoin Bottom? Koreksi Kali Ini Sudah 411 Hari'); refresh 'why is Bitcoin down' and 'Bitcoin price today' with reference levels, never a forecast. Pluang is also covering the Chainflip and Fusionist hacks, so refresh a crypto safety guide. Indodax could not be read today. Check each against Reku's pages. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins:** Among the ten largest, Hyperliquid (HYPE +2.4%) earned about $21.2 million in revenue over 7 days, up about 15.5% (PANews), and Bitcoin Core fixed a bug that could temporarily stop nodes processing blocks (PANews). The main theme is security: Chainflip, Fusionist and Fluidkey were hacked and Upbit and Bithumb paused CYBER transfers (PANews). On Reku's new listings, Fusionist (ACE, -17% in 7 days) was hit by the bridge exploit, Midnight (NIGHT, +10% in 24 hours) signed a Japan financial-sector deal according to Pluang, and DODO is up about 29% in 7 days with no stated reason.
